name: cpzai
description: AI-native systematic trading — build strategies, backtest, manage risk, and execute trades. Connects to CPZAI for live portfolio, market data, and order management.

cpz_api_key.title: CPZ API Key
cpz_api_key.description: Your CPZAI API key. Generate one at https://ai.cpz-lab.com → Settings → API Keys. Leave blank to authenticate via OAuth instead.

cpz_api_secret.title: CPZ API Secret
cpz_api_secret.description: Your CPZAI API secret (paired with the key above). Stored in your system keychain. Leave blank to use OAuth.

default_environment.title: Default Trading Environment
default_environment.description: Default broker environment for new orders. Set to 'paper' to require explicit override before any live trade.

require_trade_confirmation.title: Require trade confirmation
require_trade_confirmation.description: When true, every place_order and execute_strategy call prompts for explicit user confirmation. Recommended.
